snippet.title: Gray Planet // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3097220/Gray_Planet/

Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

Developed by 
Paston Studios aka @spewcode
